name: Camp Skylemar
description_short: Overnight camp for boys ages 7 to 15 on Trickey Pond in Naples, Maine. Days center on land and water sports with private instruction, plus a ropes course, arts, woodshop and trips.
swim_waterfront_notes: On Trickey Pond, about three miles long. The camp lists swimming, waterskiing, wakeboarding, tubing, sailing, canoeing, kayaking, paddleboarding, snorkeling and fishing.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Footer gives the address, phone and email. The FAQ describes escorted group flights and a coach bus; the cost of travel is not stated.
